content: Video course piracy cannot be fully prevented; signed/expiring URLs (2-6h expiry) tied to session, domain restriction, and watermarking make piracy traceable/harder but any determined user can screen-record; bandwidth costs scale with views x video size, small dedicated video-hosting plans run ~US9+/mo for ~2.4TB; raw S3+CloudFront egress can spike unpredictably without a CDN/hosting plan with caps.
